explication: HaKa Comic is a third-party, cross-platform HaKa comic client. The README describes browsing categories, manga listings and details, then reading; those Flutter screens are not present in the supplied tree, so their nodes have no source path. The visible runtime code covers Rust ZIP and image/PDF operations plus native folder-picking and Android download-saving bridges. Platform-specific Flutter UI and most bridge wiring are outside the excerpts; unsupported links are omitted.
